lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately four to five horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, showing a semi-regular spatial distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly elevated pixel intensity intersecting the horizontal tiers of blobs to form a grid-like structural arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three dominant horizontal linear features on the upper flank characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity upper pixels to low-intensity shadow pixels below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, high-luminance linear mark (diagonal scar) is visible on the upper-lateral flank immediately posterior to the branchial region.
other_distinctive_markers: The leading edge and surface of the pectoral fin exhibit a dense distribution of smaller, lower-contrast circular clusters compared to the primary lateral constellation.
